Product Profile
A high-yielding, late-maturing, semi-tall variety with long slender grains, MTU-1075 is extensively cultivated in South India. Developed by ANGRAU University (Maruteru) and released in 2008, it is highly adapted to irrigated lowlands. Renowned for its good cooking quality, it exhibits tolerance to important diseases and insect pests, along with moderate HRR. Additionally, it boasts good grain weight, further enhancing its appeal to farmers.
